description: The owner-confirmed price for one of a business's services, by service name (ideally a name from getBusinessInfo). grounded:false means no confirmed price exists — never invent one; for an exact quote the customer asks the business on its front desk page (origin in getBusinessInfo) or calls its confirmed phone.

businessId.description: The business's ServiceFront slug, the first label of its <slug>.servicefront.ai address. Find it with searchBusinesses if you only know the name.

service.description: The service to price — ideally one of the business's listed service names.

name: getQuote
title: Get an owner-confirmed price
